postUrls.title: Post / reel URLs
postUrls.description: Public Instagram post or reel URLs to scrape. Enter one URL per item.

maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post
maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of qualifying top-level comments and replies to save for each post before stopping.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: When enabled, also collect replies that Instagram exposes publicly without login.

minLikes.title: Minimum comment likes
minLikes.description: Skip comments whose visible like count is below this value.

maxItems.title: Maximum total rows
maxItems.description: Hard stop for the total number of comment rows saved in one run to control cost.

maxVideosPerCreator.title: Maximum posts per creator
maxVideosPerCreator.description: Hard stop on how many supplied posts or reels from the same creator may be processed in one run.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use residential proxy
useResidentialProxy.description: Use your Apify residential proxy for the anonymous public Instagram web request. No third-party provider.

runLabel.title: Run label
runLabel.description: Optional label echoed on every output row and in SUMMARY.

sinceDate.title: Comments since date (UTC)
sinceDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; excludes older comments with known dates. Undated comments are retained.
